slide1.title: Just talk. Like a friend's on the line.
slide1.body: No journaling. No forms. Hold the mic, breathe out the chaos. Kidsit AI listens with no judgment.

slide2.title: See the moment from a calmer place.
slide2.body: You'll get back a structured read — what happened, why, and what to try. Rooted in child development research.

slide3.title: Patterns become visible. So you change them.
slide3.body: Over time, Kidsit AI surfaces the triggers, times, and contexts that keep tripping you up. Quietly, kindly.

settings.aboutNotMedical: Kidsit AI is not a medical or psychological service.
settings.aboutBody1: It is a reflective parenting companion that offers warm, science-informed guidance for everyday moments with your child.
settings.aboutBody2: The app does not diagnose, treat, or replace care from a qualified professional. If you are worried about your child's safety, development, or mental health — or your own — please speak with a pediatrician, therapist, or other licensed practitioner. In an emergency, contact your local emergency services.
settings.aboutBody3: Guidance is generated by an AI model and may occasionally be incomplete or wrong. You know your child best — trust your judgment.

aiConsent.title: Sharing your story with AI
aiConsent.body1: To give you guidance, Kidsit AI sends two things to OpenAI:
aiConsent.bullet1: The audio you record, transcribed to text by OpenAI Whisper.
aiConsent.bullet2: The transcribed text, plus the context you pick (location, mood, your child's first name and age), sent to OpenAI GPT-4o-mini for the response.
aiConsent.body2: OpenAI does not retain this data, does not link it to your identity, and does not use it to train models. Your child profiles and history remain only on this device.
aiConsent.body3: By tapping Agree below, you consent to this processing. You can revoke this at any time in Settings.
aiConsent.agree: I agree — start using Kidsit AI
aiConsent.declinedNote: You can enable AI guidance any time in Settings → Privacy.
aiConsent.settingsHintEnabled: Story text sent to OpenAI for transcription + guidance.
aiConsent.settingsHintDisabled: AI guidance disabled. Tap to enable.
